assets.reuseWhen: The approved counterclaim opening pulls rapidly away from an extreme close-up and lands on the true claim.
assets.avoidWhen: The visible movement or landing does not match this outward envelope.
assets.license: No audio master is bundled. Select a separately licensed whoosh for each production.

assets.reuseWhen: A spoken beat benefits from a fast-starting push or pull that slows into a stable new framing.
assets.avoidWhen: The crop would lose a face, gesture, evidence, or subtitle.
assets.notes: The move lands and holds. It never bounces or returns automatically; a later reverse move is a separate cue.

assets.professionalTerm: Layered Display Type with Subject Occlusion
assets.reuseWhen: A short hook can be reduced to one background phrase and one foreground beat while the presenter remains readable.
assets.avoidWhen: The subject matte is unreliable or the copy cannot be reduced.
assets.notes: Keep display text horizontal. Colors, hierarchy, blur, underline, glow, and duration are episode decisions.

assets.reuseWhen: A factual noun or action has authentic matching evidence and a clear spoken cue.
assets.avoidWhen: The material only decorates the topic or appears before the audience knows what to inspect.

assets.reuseWhen: Evidence must first be understood at full size and then remain relevant beside the presenter.
assets.avoidWhen: The destination would cover a face or caption, or the evidence becomes meaningless when small.
assets.notes: Pass explicit destination geometry after face and caption safe areas are known.

assets.reuseWhen: Several recognizable authentic sources support one spoken claim.
assets.avoidWhen: The audience must read dense copy or the sources do not share one argument.

assets.reuseWhen: Several recognizable pages should open from behind a presenter as one spatial relationship.
assets.avoidWhen: The cards would cover both presenters or cannot share a believable pivot.

assets.reuseWhen: Two to five parallel ideas can occupy a shallow arc around a visible presenter.
assets.avoidWhen: The presenter is too close or the ideas are sequential rather than parallel.
assets.notes: Cards need independent x/y/z/yaw/roll and partial overlap; never flatten them into a PPT row.

assets.reuseWhen: The same authentic materials persist through capture, organization, and reuse.
assets.avoidWhen: The items change between stages or the transformation is merely decorative.

assets.reuseWhen: Real footage cannot directly show an abstract claim and generated parts can perform a clear action.
assets.avoidWhen: A static generated composition would be mistaken for animation or factual evidence.

assets.reuseWhen: The speaker must remain primary while surrounding material visibly recedes.
assets.avoidWhen: The source is already too close or a meaningful full-frame gesture would be lost.
assets.notes: Protect eyes, mouth, hands, captions, and persistent UI. Isolation does not require default background blur.

communicates: speaker continuity beside a primary board
assets.reuseWhen: A horizontal source must remain uncropped inside a rounded vertical window.
assets.avoidWhen: A true portrait crop is possible or the window would be mistaken for a filled crop.
assets.notes: Map source width to the window long edge; preserve aspect ratio; use a flat field, never blur-fill or stretching.

assets.reuseWhen: The current scene can meaningfully become a container in the next scene.
assets.avoidWhen: The destination has no semantic relationship to the shrinking content.

assets.reuseWhen: A chapter can use a calm black spatial bridge and the complete paths have time to establish.
assets.avoidWhen: The lines would be arbitrary, cropped, dashed, or rushed.

assets.reuseWhen: The chapter is genuinely about nodes or relationships and the field exists only during the transition.
assets.avoidWhen: Dots or lines would remain as decoration over dialogue.

assets.reuseWhen: The cut benefits from a digital material change rather than an optical flash.
assets.avoidWhen: The pixel field has no relation to the topic or is repeated at every boundary.

assets.reuseWhen: Outgoing and incoming frames can meet at a 1–3 frame near-white peak.
assets.avoidWhen: The scene is already near-white or the flash would damage legibility.
